title: DIAL: Direct Iterative Adversarial Learning for Realistic Multi-Turn Dialogue Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2512.20773v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Realistic user simulation is crucial for training and evaluating multi-turn dialogue systems, yet creating simulators that accurately replicate human behavior remains a significant challenge. An effective simulator must expose the failure modes of the systems under evaluation. This work introduces Direct Iterative Adversarial Learning (DIAL), an adversarial framework that iteratively enhances user simulator realism through a competitive dynamic between a generator (user simulator) and a discriminator. When applied to mental health support, a domain characterized by diverse failure types and a critical dependence on realistic user behavior for failure detection, DIAL restores lexical diversity diminished by supervised fine-tuning and drastically reduces discriminator accuracy. The resulting simulator exhibits a strong correlation between simulated and real failure occurrence rates while maintaining low distributional divergence of fai

translated_title: DIAL：面向逼真多轮对话模拟的直接迭代对抗学习
translated_abstract: 逼真的用户模拟对于训练和评估多轮对话系统至关重要，然而构建能够准确复现人类行为的模拟器仍然是一项重大挑战。一个有效的模拟器必须能够暴露被评估系统的失败模式。本工作提出了直接迭代对抗学习（DIAL），这是一个通过生成器（用户模拟器）与判别器之间的竞争性动态来迭代提升用户模拟器逼真度的对抗框架。当应用于心理健康支持领域——该领域的特点是失败类型多样，且失败检测严重依赖于逼真的用户行为——DIAL 恢复了被监督微调所削弱的词汇多样性，并大幅降低了判别器的准确率。所得的模拟器在模拟失败发生率与真实失败发生率之间表现出强相关性，同时保持了失败分布的低散度。
tldr: 提出 DIAL 对抗框架，通过生成器（用户模拟器）与判别器的竞争性动态迭代提升多轮对话用户模拟的逼真度，在心理健康支持场景中恢复了词汇多样性，并使模拟失败率与真实失败率高度相关。
en_tdlr: DIAL is an adversarial framework that iteratively enhances user simulator realism in multi-turn dialogue through competitive dynamics between a generator and a discriminator, restoring lexical diversity and strongly correlating simulated with real failure rates in mental health support scenarios.
